verses.en: Ha Mim

verses.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge

verses.ar: غَافِرِ الذَّنۭۡ بِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوۡبِ شَدِيۡدِ الۡعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوۡلِؕ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ اِلَيۡهِ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
verses.en: Who forgiveth sin, accepteth repentance, is strict in punishment, and hath a long reach (in all things). there is no god but He: to Him is the final goal

verses.ar: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَلَا يَغۡرُرۡكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمۡ فِي الۡبِلَادِ
verses.en: None can dispute about the Signs of Allah but the Unbelievers. Let not, then, their strutting about through the land deceive thee

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ وَّالۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡࣕ وَهَمَّتۡ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُوۡلِهِمۡ لِيَاۡخُذُوۡهُ وَجَادَلُوۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُوۡا بِهِ الۡحَقَّ فَاَخَذۡتُهُمۡࣞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
verses.en: But (there were people) before them, who denied (the Signs),- the People of Noah, and the Confederates (of Evil) after them; and every People plotted against their prophet, to seize him, and disputed by means of vanities, therewith to condemn the Truth; but it was I that seized them! and how (terrible) was My Requital

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِۘؔ‏
verses.en: Thus was the Decree of thy Lord proved true against the Unbelievers; that truly they are Companions of the Fire

verses.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ يَحۡمِلُوۡنَ الۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهٗ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاۚ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ رَّحۡمَةً وَّعِلۡمًا فَاغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِيۡنَ تَابُوۡا وَاتَّبَعُوۡا سَبِيۡلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِ
verses.en: Those who sustain the Throne (of Allah) and those around it Sing Glory and Praise to their Lord; believe in Him; and implore Forgiveness for those who believe: "Our Lord! Thy Reach is over all things, in Mercy and Knowledge. Forgive, then, those who turn in Repentance, and follow Thy Path; and preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا وَاَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنّٰتِ عَدۡنِ اِۨلَّتِيۡ وَعَدۡتَّهُمۡ وَمَنۡ صَلَحَ مِنۡ اٰبَآئِهِمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيّٰتِهِمۡؕ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: And grant, our Lord! that they enter the Gardens of Eternity, which Thou hast promised to them, and to the righteous among their fathers, their wives, and their posterity! For Thou art (He), the Exalted in Might, Full of Wisdom

verses.ar: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ وَمَنۡ تَقِ السَّيِّاٰتِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهٗؕ وَذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِيۡمُࣖ‏
verses.en: And preserve them from (all) ills; and any whom Thou dost preserve from ills that Day,- on them wilt Thou have bestowed Mercy indeed: and that will be truly (for them) the highest Achievement

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ اللّٰهِ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ مَّقۡتِكُمۡ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ اِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَي الۡاِيۡمَانِ فَتَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: The Unbelievers will be addressed: "Greater was the aversion of Allah to you than (is) your aversion to yourselves, seeing that ye were called to the Faith and ye used to refuse

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا٘ اَمَتَّنَا اثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَاَحۡيَيۡتَنَا اثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَاعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوۡبِنَا فَهَلۡ اِلٰي خُرُوۡجٍ مِّنۡ سَبِيۡلٍ
verses.en: They will say: "Our Lord! twice hast Thou made us without life, and twice hast Thou given us Life! Now have we recognised our sins: Is there any way out (of this)

verses.ar: ذٰلِكُمۡ بِاَنَّهٗ٘ اِذَا دُعِيَ اللّٰهُ وَحۡدَهٗ كَفَرۡتُمۡۚ وَاِنۡ يُّشۡرَكۡ بِهٖ تُؤۡمِنُوۡاؕ فَالۡحُكۡمُ لِلّٰهِ الۡعَلِيِّ الۡكَبِيۡرِ
verses.en: (The answer will be:) "This is because, when Allah was invoked as the Only (object of worship), ye did reject Faith, but when partners were joined to Him, ye believed! the Command is with Allah, Most High, Most Great

verses.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ رِزۡقًاؕ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ اِلَّا مَنۡ يُّنِيۡبُ
verses.en: He it is Who showeth you his Signs, and sendeth down sustenance for you from the sky: but only those receive admonition who turn (to Allah)

verses.ar: فَادۡعُوا اللّٰهَ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Call ye, then, upon Allah with sincere devotion to Him, even though the Unbelievers may detest it

verses.ar: رَفِيۡعُ الدَّرَجٰتِ ذُو الۡعَرۡشِۚ يُلۡقِي الرُّوۡحَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِهٖ عَلٰي مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ لِيُنۡذِرَ يَوۡمَ التَّلَاقِۙ‏
verses.en: Raised high above ranks (or degrees), (He is) the Lord of the Throne (of Authority): by His Command doth He send the Spirit (of inspiration) to any of His servants he pleases, that it may warn (men) of the Day of Mutual Meeting

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ بَارِزُوۡنَ ࣢ۚ لَا يَخۡفٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءٌؕ لِمَنِ الۡمُلۡكُ الۡيَوۡمَؕ لِلّٰهِ الۡوَاحِدِ الۡقَهَّارِ
verses.en: The Day whereon they will (all) come forth: not a single thing concerning them is hidden from Allah. Whose will be the dominion that Day?" That of Allah, the One the Irresistible

verses.ar: اَلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزٰي كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡؕ لَا ظُلۡمَ الۡيَوۡمَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيۡعُ الۡحِسَابِ
verses.en: That Day will every soul be requited for what it earned; no injustice will there be that Day, for Allah is Swift in taking account

verses.ar: وَاَنۡذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡاٰزِفَةِ اِذِ الۡقُلُوۡبُ لَدَي الۡحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِيۡنَ ࣢ؕ مَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ مِنۡ حَمِيۡمٍ وَّلَا شَفِيۡعٍ يُّطَاعُؕ‏
verses.en: Warn them of the Day that is (ever) drawing near, when the hearts will (come) right up to the throats to choke (them); No intimate friend nor intercessor will the wrong-doers have, who could be listened to

verses.ar: يَعۡلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ الۡاَعۡيُنِ وَمَا تُخۡفِي الصُّدُوۡرُ
verses.en: (Allah) knows of (the tricks) that deceive with the eyes, and all that the hearts (of men) conceal

verses.ar: وَاللّٰهُ يَقۡضِيۡ بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ لَا يَقۡضُوۡنَ بِشَيۡءٍؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُࣖ‏
verses.en: And Allah will judge with (justice and) Truth: but those whom (men) invoke besides Him, will not (be in a position) to judge at all. Verily it is Allah (alone) Who hears and sees (all things)

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَانُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَانُوۡا هُمۡ اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةً وَّاٰثَارًا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوۡبِهِمۡؕ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّاقٍ
verses.en: Do they not travel through the earth and see what was the End of those before them? They were even superior to them in strength, and in the traces (they have left) in the land: but Allah did call them to account for their sins, and none had they to defend them against Allah

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَانَتۡ تَّاۡتِيۡهِمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَكَفَرُوۡا فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِ
verses.en: That was because there came to them their messengers with Clear (Signs), but they rejected them: So Allah called them to account: for He is Full of Strength, Strict in Punishment

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: Of old We sent Moses, with Our Signs and an authority manifest

verses.ar: اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَ وَقَارُوۡنَ فَقَالُوۡا سٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.en: To Pharaoh, Haman, and Qarun; but they called (him)" a sorcerer telling lies

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِنۡدِنَا قَالُوا اقۡتُلُوۡ٘ا اَبۡنَآءَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ وَاسۡتَحۡيُوۡا نِسَآءَهُمۡؕ وَمَا كَيۡدُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اِلَّا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ
verses.en: Now, when he came to them in Truth, from Us, they said, "Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and keep alive their females," but the plots of Unbelievers (end) in nothing but errors (and delusions)

verses.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُوۡنِيۡ٘ اَقۡتُلۡ مُوۡسٰي وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهٗؕۚ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّبَدِّلَ دِيۡنَكُمۡ اَوۡ اَنۡ يُّظۡهِرَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ الۡفَسَادَ
verses.en: Said Pharaoh: "Leave me to slay Moses; and let him call on his Lord! What I fear is lest he should change your religion, or lest he should cause mischief to appear in the land

verses.ar: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنِّيۡ عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّيۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِࣖ‏
verses.en: Moses said: "I have indeed called upon my Lord and your Lord (for protection) from every arrogant one who believes not in the Day of Account

verses.ar: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤۡمِنٌࣗۖ مِّنۡ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَكۡتُمُ اِيۡمَانَهٗ٘ اَتَقۡتُلُوۡنَ رَجُلًا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلَ رَبِّيَ اللّٰهُ وَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡؕ وَاِنۡ يَّكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيۡهِ كَذِبُهٗۚ وَاِنۡ يَّكُ صَادِقًا يُّصِبۡكُمۡ بَعۡضُ الَّذِيۡ يَعِدُكُمۡؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.en: A believer, a man from among the people of Pharaoh, who had concealed his faith, said: "Will ye slay a man because he says, 'My Lord is Allah'?- when he has indeed come to you with Clear (Signs) from your Lord? and if he be a liar, on him is (the sin of) his lie: but, if he is telling the Truth, then will fall on you something of the (calamity) of which he warns you: Truly Allah guides not one who transgresses and lies

verses.ar: يٰقَوۡمِ لَكُمُ الۡمُلۡكُ الۡيَوۡمَ ظٰهِرِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؗ فَمَنۡ يَّنۡصُرُنَا مِنۭۡ بَاۡسِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ جَآءَنَاؕ قَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ مَا٘ اُرِيۡكُمۡ اِلَّا مَا٘ اَرٰي وَمَا٘ اَهۡدِيۡكُمۡ اِلَّا سَبِيۡلَ الرَّشَادِ
verses.en: O my People! Yours is the dominion this day: Ye have the upper hand in the land: but who will help us from the Punishment of Allah, should it befall us?" Pharaoh said: "I but point out to you that which I see (myself); Nor do I guide you but to the Path of Right

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اٰمَنَ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ الۡاَحۡزَابِۙ‏
verses.en: Then said the man who believed: "O my people! Truly I do fear for you something like the Day (of disaster) of the Confederates (in sin)

verses.ar: مِثۡلَ دَاۡبِ قَوۡمِ نُوۡحٍ وَّعَادٍ وَّثَمُوۡدَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ يُرِيۡدُ ظُلۡمًا لِّلۡعِبَادِ
verses.en: Something like the fate of the People of Noah, the 'Ad, and the Thamud, and those who came after them: but Allah never wishes injustice to his Servants

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَوۡمَ التَّنَادِۙ‏
verses.en: And O my people! I fear for you a Day when there will be Mutual calling (and wailing)

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّوۡنَ مُدۡبِرِيۡنَۚ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٍۚ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ هَادٍ
verses.en: A Day when ye shall turn your backs and flee: No defender shall ye have from Allah: Any whom Allah leaves to stray, there is none to guide

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ يُوۡسُفُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَمَا زِلۡتُمۡ فِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُمۡ بِهٖؕ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا هَلَكَ قُلۡتُمۡ لَنۡ يَّبۡعَثَ اللّٰهُ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ رَسُوۡلًاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ مَنۡ هُوَ مُسۡرِفٌ مُّرۡتَابُۚۖ‏
verses.en: And to you there came Joseph in times gone by, with Clear Signs, but ye ceased not to doubt of the (Mission) for which he had come: At length, when he died, ye said: 'No messenger will Allah send after him.' thus doth Allah leave to stray such as transgress and live in doubt

verses.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطٰنٍ اَتٰىهُمۡؕ كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَعِنۡدَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ قَلۡبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ
verses.en: (Such) as dispute about the Signs of Allah, without any authority that hath reached them, grievous and odious (is such conduct) in the sight of Allah and of the Believers. Thus doth Allah, seal up every heart - of arrogant and obstinate Transgressors

verses.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يٰهَامٰنُ ابۡنِ لِيۡ صَرۡحًا لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اَبۡلُغُ الۡاَسۡبَابَۙ‏
verses.en: Pharaoh said: "O Haman! Build me a lofty palace, that I may attain the ways and means

verses.ar: اَسۡبَابَ السَّمٰوٰتِ فَاَطَّلِعَ اِلٰ٘ي اِلٰهِ مُوۡسٰي وَاِنِّيۡ لَاَظُنُّهٗ كَاذِبًاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوۡٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِؕ وَمَا كَيۡدُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِلَّا فِيۡ تَبَابٍࣖ‏
verses.en: The ways and means of (reaching) the heavens, and that I may mount up to the god of Moses: But as far as I am concerned, I think (Moses) is a liar!" Thus was made alluring, in Pharaoh's eyes, the evil of his deeds, and he was hindered from the Path; and the plot of Pharaoh led to nothing but perdition (for him)

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اٰمَنَ يٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوۡنِ اَهۡدِكُمۡ سَبِيۡلَ الرَّشَادِۚ‏
verses.en: The man who believed said further: "O my people! Follow me: I will lead you to the Path of Right

verses.ar: يٰقَوۡمِ اِنَّمَا هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَا مَتَاعٌؗ وَّاِنَّ الۡاٰخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الۡقَرَارِ
verses.en: O my people! This life of the present is nothing but (temporary) convenience: It is the Hereafter that is the Home that will last

verses.ar: مَنۡ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجۡزٰ٘ي اِلَّا مِثۡلَهَاۚ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّنۡ ذَكَرٍ اَوۡ اُنۡثٰي وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ يَدۡخُلُوۡنَ الۡجَنَّةَ يُرۡزَقُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: He that works evil will not be requited but by the like thereof: and he that works a righteous deed - whether man or woman - and is a Believer- such will enter the Garden (of Bliss): Therein will they have abundance without measure

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ مَا لِيۡ٘ اَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ اِلَي النَّجٰوةِ وَتَدۡعُوۡنَنِيۡ٘ اِلَي النَّارِؕ‏
verses.en: And O my people! How (strange) it is for me to call you to Salvation while ye call me to the Fire

verses.ar: تَدۡعُوۡنَنِيۡ لِاَكۡفُرَ بِاللّٰهِ وَاُشۡرِكَ بِهٖ مَا لَيۡسَ لِيۡ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌؗ وَّاَنَا اَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ اِلَي الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡغَفَّارِ
verses.en: Ye do call upon me to blaspheme against Allah, and to join with Him partners of whom I have no knowledge; and I call you to the Exalted in Power, Who forgives again and again

verses.ar: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّمَا تَدۡعُوۡنَنِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِ لَيۡسَ لَهٗ دَعۡوَةٌ فِي الدُّنۡيَا وَلَا فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَاَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ وَاَنَّ الۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِ
verses.en: Without doubt ye do call me to one who is not fit to be called to, whether in this world, or in the Hereafter; our return will be to Allah; and the Transgressors will be Companions of the Fire

verses.ar: فَسَتَذۡكُرُوۡنَ مَا٘ اَقُوۡلُ لَكُمۡؕ وَاُفَوِّضُ اَمۡرِيۡ٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بَصِيۡرٌۭ بِالۡعِبَادِ
verses.en: Soon will ye remember what I say to you (now), My (own) affair I commit to Allah: for Allah (ever) watches over His Servants

verses.ar: فَوَقٰىهُ اللّٰهُ سَيِّاٰتِ مَا مَكَرُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِاٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ سُوۡٓءُ الۡعَذَابِۚ‏
verses.en: Then Allah saved him from (every) ill that they plotted (against him), but the burnt of the Penalty encompassed on all sides the People of Pharaoh

verses.ar: اَلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوًّا وَّعَشِيًّاۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُࣞ اَدۡخِلُوۡ٘ا اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اَشَدَّ الۡعَذَابِ
verses.en: In front of the Fire will they be brought, morning and evening: And (the sentence will be) on the Day that Judgment will be established: "Cast ye the People of Pharaoh into the severest Penalty

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ يَتَحَآجُّوۡنَ فِي النَّارِ فَيَقُوۡلُ الضُّعَفٰٓؤُا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمۡ تَبَعًا فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّغۡنُوۡنَ عَنَّا نَصِيۡبًا مِّنَ النَّارِ
verses.en: Behold, they will dispute with each other in the Fire! The weak ones (who followed) will say to those who had been arrogant, "We but followed you: Can ye then take (on yourselves) from us some share of the Fire

verses.ar: قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيۡهَا٘ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدۡ حَكَمَ بَيۡنَ الۡعِبَادِ
verses.en: Those who had been arrogant will say: "We are all in this (Fire)! Truly, Allah has judged between (his) Servants

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ فِي النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادۡعُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ يُخَفِّفۡ عَنَّا يَوۡمًا مِّنَ الۡعَذَابِ
verses.en: Those in the Fire will say to the Keepers of Hell: "Pray to your Lord to lighten us the Penalty for a day (at least)

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَوَلَمۡ تَكُ تَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ رُسُلُكُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِؕ قَالُوۡا بَلٰيؕ قَالُوۡا فَادۡعُوۡاۚ وَمَا دُعٰٓؤُا الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اِلَّا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍࣖ‏
verses.en: They will say: "Did there not come to you your messengers with Clear Signs?" They will say, "Yes". They will reply, "Then pray (as ye like)! But the prayer of those without Faith is nothing but (futile wandering) in (mazes of) error

verses.ar: اِنَّا لَنَنۡصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَيَوۡمَ يَقُوۡمُ الۡاَشۡهَادُۙ‏
verses.en: We will, without doubt, help our messengers and those who believe, (both) in this world's life and on the Day when the Witnesses will stand forth

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنۡفَعُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعۡنَةُ وَلَهُمۡ سُوۡٓءُ الدَّارِ
verses.en: The Day when no profit will it be to Wrong-doers to present their excuses, but they will (only) have the Curse and the Home of Misery

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡهُدٰي وَاَوۡرَثۡنَا بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ الۡكِتٰبَۙ‏
verses.en: We did aforetime give Moses the (Book of) Guidance, and We gave the book in inheritance to the Children of Israel

verses.ar: هُدًي وَّذِكۡرٰي لِاُولِي الۡاَلۡبَابِ
verses.en: A Guide and a Message to men of Understanding

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّاسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۭۡ بِكَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ بِالۡعَشِيِّ وَالۡاِبۡكَارِ
verses.en: Patiently, then, persevere: for the Promise of Allah is true: and ask forgiveness for thy fault, and celebrate the Praises of thy Lord in the evening and in the morning

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بِغَيۡرِ سُلۡطٰنٍ اَتٰىهُمۡۙ اِنۡ فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِهِمۡ اِلَّا كِبۡرٌ مَّا هُمۡ بِبَالِغِيۡهِۚ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡبَصِيۡرُ
verses.en: Those who dispute about the signs of Allah without any authority bestowed on them,- there is nothing in their breasts but (the quest of) greatness, which they shall never attain to: seek refuge, then, in Allah: It is He Who hears and sees (all things)

verses.ar: لَخَلۡقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ خَلۡقِ النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Assuredly the creation of the heavens and the earth is a greater (matter) than the creation of men: Yet most men understand not

verses.ar: وَمَا يَسۡتَوِي الۡاَعۡمٰي وَالۡبَصِيۡرُ ࣢ۙ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَلَا الۡمُسِيۡٓءُؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Not equal are the blind and those who (clearly) see: Nor are (equal) those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, and those who do evil. Little do ye learn by admonition

verses.ar: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهَاؗ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: The Hour will certainly come: Therein is no doubt: Yet most men believe not

verses.ar: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادۡعُوۡنِيۡ٘ اَسۡتَجِبۡ لَكُمۡؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِيۡ سَيَدۡخُلُوۡنَ جَهَنَّمَ دٰخِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And your Lord says: "Call on Me; I will answer your (Prayer): but those who are too arrogant to serve Me will surely find themselves in Hell - in humiliation

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ لِتَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَذُوۡ فَضۡلٍ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is Allah Who has made the Night for you, that ye may rest therein, and the days as that which helps (you) to see. Verily Allah is full of Grace and Bounty to men: yet most men give no thanks

verses.ar: ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍۘ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؗ فَاَنّٰي تُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ
verses.en: Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, there is no god but He: Then how ye are deluded away from the Truth

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ يُؤۡفَكُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Thus are deluded those who are wont to reject the Signs of Allah

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ قَرَارًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَّصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَاَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡ وَرَزَقَكُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبُّكُمۡۚۖ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: It is Allah Who has made for you the earth as a resting place, and the sky as a canopy, and has given you shape- and made your shapes beautiful,- and has provided for you Sustenance, of things pure and good;- such is Allah your Lord. So Glory to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: هُوَ الۡحَيُّ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَادۡعُوۡهُ مُخۡلِصِيۡنَ لَهُ الدِّيۡنَؕ اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: He is the Living (One): There is no god but He: Call upon Him, giving Him sincere devotion. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنِّيۡ نُهِيۡتُ اَنۡ اَعۡبُدَ الَّذِيۡنَ تَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِيَ الۡبَيِّنٰتُ مِنۡ رَّبِّيۡؗ وَاُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اُسۡلِمَ لِرَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "I have been forbidden to invoke those whom ye invoke besides Allah,- seeing that the Clear Signs have come to me from my Lord; and I have been commanded to bow (in Islam) to the Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُكُمۡ طِفۡلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبۡلُغُوۡ٘ا اَشُدَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ لِتَكُوۡنُوۡا شُيُوۡخًاۚ وَمِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يُّتَوَفّٰي مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوۡ٘ا اَجَلًا مُّسَمًّي وَّلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is He Who has created you from dust then from a sperm-drop, then from a leech-like clot; then does he get you out (into the light) as a child: then lets you (grow and) reach your age of full strength; then lets you become old,- though of you there are some who die before;- and lets you reach a Term appointed; in order that ye may learn wisdom

verses.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُحۡيٖ وَيُمِيۡتُۚ فَاِذَا قَضٰ٘ي اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُࣖ‏
verses.en: It is He Who gives Life and Death; and when He decides upon an affair, He says to it, "Be", and it is

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ يُجَادِلُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِؕ اَنّٰي يُصۡرَفُوۡنَۙۛ‏
verses.en: Seest thou not those that dispute concerning the Signs of Allah? How are they turned away (from Reality)

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِالۡكِتٰبِ وَبِمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا بِهٖ رُسُلَنَاࣞۛ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Those who reject the Book and the (revelations) with which We sent our messengers: but soon shall they know

verses.ar: اِذِ الۡاَغۡلٰلُ فِيۡ٘ اَعۡنَاقِهِمۡ وَالسَّلٰسِلُؕ يُسۡحَبُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: When the yokes (shall be) round their necks, and the chains; they shall be dragged along

verses.ar: فِي الۡحَمِيۡمِ ࣢ۙ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسۡجَرُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: In the boiling fetid fluid: then in the Fire shall they be burned

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَيۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Then shall it be said to them: "Where are the (deities) to which ye gave part-worship

verses.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ قَالُوۡا ضَلُّوۡا عَنَّا بَلۡ لَّمۡ نَكُنۡ نَّدۡعُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ شَيۡـًٔاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: In derogation of Allah?" They will reply: "They have left us in the lurch: Nay, we invoked not, of old, anything (that had real existence)." Thus does Allah leave the Unbelievers to stray

verses.ar: ذٰلِكُمۡ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَفۡرَحُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَمۡرَحُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: That was because ye were wont to rejoice on the earth in things other than the Truth, and that ye were wont to be insolent

verses.ar: اُدۡخُلُوۡ٘ا اَبۡوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۚ فَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَي الۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ
verses.en: Enter ye the gates of Hell, to dwell therein: and evil is (this) abode of the arrogant

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّۚ فَاِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعۡضَ الَّذِيۡ نَعِدُهُمۡ اَوۡ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَاِلَيۡنَا يُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: So persevere in patience; for the Promise of Allah is true: and whether We show thee (in this life) some part of what We promise them,- or We take thy soul (to Our Mercy) (before that),-(in any case) it is to Us that they shall (all) return

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلًا مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ لَّمۡ نَقۡصُصۡ عَلَيۡكَؕ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُوۡلٍ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَ بِاٰيَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُ اللّٰهِ قُضِيَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: We did aforetime send messengers before thee: of them there are some whose story We have related to thee, and some whose story We have not related to thee. It was not (possible) for any messenger to bring a sign except by the leave of Allah: but when the Command of Allah issued, the matter was decided in truth and justice, and there perished, there and then those who stood on Falsehoods

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَنۡعَامَ لِتَرۡكَبُوۡا مِنۡهَا وَمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَؗ‏
verses.en: It is Allah Who made cattle for you, that ye may use some for riding and some for food

verses.ar: وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ وَلِتَبۡلُغُوۡا عَلَيۡهَا حَاجَةً فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِكُمۡ وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَي الۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: And there are (other) advantages in them for you (besides); that ye may through them attain to any need (there may be) in your hearts; and on them and on ships ye are carried

verses.ar: وَيُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖࣗۖ فَاَيَّ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُنۡكِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And He shows you (always) His Signs: then which of the Signs of Allah will ye deny

verses.ar: اَفَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَكۡثَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَاَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَّاٰثَارًا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَمَا٘ اَغۡنٰي عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: Do they not travel through the earth and see what was the End of those before them? They were more numerous than these and superior in strength and in the traces (they have left) in the land: Yet all that they accomplished was of no profit to them

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَرِحُوۡا بِمَا عِنۡدَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡعِلۡمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.en: For when their messengers came to them with Clear Signs, they exulted in such knowledge (and skill) as they had; but that very (Wrath) at which they were wont to scoff hemmed them in

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَاَوۡا بَاۡسَنَا قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَحۡدَهٗ وَكَفَرۡنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهٖ مُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
verses.en: But when they saw Our Punishment, they said: "We believe in Allah,- the one Allah - and we reject the partners we used to join with Him

verses.ar: فَلَمۡ يَكُ يَنۡفَعُهُمۡ اِيۡمَانُهُمۡ لَمَّا رَاَوۡا بَاۡسَنَاؕ سُنَّتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِيۡ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ فِيۡ عِبَادِهٖۚ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: But their professing the Faith when they (actually) saw Our Punishment was not going to profit them. (Such has been) Allah's Way of dealing with His Servants (from the most ancient times). And even thus did the Rejecters of Allah perish (utterly)
